ideas.pitch: A localized risk detection platform built for San Antonio merchants and credit unions to screen transactions using graph intelligence and explainable machine learning.
ideas.title: San Antonio Small Business AML Risk Radar
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven high-performance pattern of graph intelligence combined with explainable models seen in past winning fraud platforms.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace where tourists can book and pay local guides using USDC escrow smart contracts on Base.
ideas.title: San Antonio River Walk Autonomous Tourist Escrow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs the successful autonomous agent marketplace architecture combined with crypto escrow payments that dominated the Synthesis Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition and wellness platform tailored to campus dining hall menus, delivering personalized meal plans and nutritional tracking for college students.
ideas.title: UTSA Student Health & Nutrition Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a pain familiar to students and university organizers in the room, mirroring the winning strategy of the Hour Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A forecasting dashboard utilizing Poisson regression and rolling backtests to predict energy grid and infrastructure anomalies across Texas.
ideas.title: Texas Grid AI Incident Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies rigorous statistical forecasting and calibrated prediction intervals that won the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered logistics app that groups nearby senior citizens in San Antonio into social outings and pairs them with verified local volunteer drivers.
ideas.title: Bexar County Senior Mobility Network
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers a clear, quantified social impact with local community relevance, following the grand prize winner at the Vanderbilt Global Good Hackathon.
